[[Start]] <<nobr>> <<set $player.passage to passage()>> <p> The two of you chat away about everything and nothing while the bus transports you through the thankfully sparse traffic. Before long, the rows of mostly student housing give way to the town centre: taller brick-built buildings made to look older than they are, interspersed with more modern looking ones, housing all manner of shops, cafes, and restaurants. And of course a significant number of pubs, their beer gardens already bustling with students starting of the day's drinking in the glorious sunlight, alongside office workers having a cheeky pint on their lunch breaks.<br><br> <span class = "other1">"The next stop is: Market Street,"</span> the bus' automated voice announced over the speakers.<br><br> The two of you grab your belongings and make your way down the stairs as the bus pulls in to the stop. After thanking the driver, you hop off into the bright sunshine, the air hitting you like a wall of heat after the air conditioned cool of the bus.<br><br> <span class = "sarah">"So, pub?"</span> $sarah.name says, spinning around and grinning at you. You nod in agreement and follow your friend as she leads you through the busy streets, winding between shoppers and dodging the ever-present preachers shouting about god to anyone who will listen.<br><br> Emerging out into the market square from atop a small flight of steps, you can see just how many people are out and about. The wide pedestrianised area between the tightly packed market on your left and the wall of shops on your right is full of people winding between one another. Beyond the stalls, shoppers are sat wherever there is space, perched on walls and lounging on patches of grass, filling the benches and picnic tables. The smells of food from the market stalls waft through the air, enticing you towards them, but you stay the course, ignoring the siren-call of fish and chips, even though it's just the thing for a day like this. At least avoiding the market proper also means avoiding the worst of the crowds; the narrow aisles between the stalls are bound to become like an oven on a hot day when they're packed with people.<br><br> $sarah.name leads you down hill through the town centre, past the busy shops that surround the square and towards the canal. You've already passed a few pubs in the market, but those will be absolutely teeming, the ones a little further out will be a bit more chill at least, but doubtless they won't be quiet by any means.<br><br> Before long you arrive at your destination: The Fox and Crown. A relatively small pub that backs directly onto the canal, built to look older than it truly is, much like many of the buildings in the city. Although it's definitely less busy than the ones on the market square, every table in the building is occupied, and no doubt upstairs won't be any different. Thankfully the two of you are able to make your way to the bar with relative ease, carfully picking your way past the tables.<br><br> <span class = "sarah">"So, what're you having?"</span> $sarah.name asks. You glance at what they have on tap.<br><br> <<button [[Summer means cider|0-1-midday-canal]]>><<set $player.drink to "cider">><<set $player.money -= 8>><</button>><br><br> <<button [[Nothing beats a pint of bitter|0-1-midday-canal]]>><<set $player.drink to "lager">><<set $player.money -= 8>><</button>><br><br> <<button [[How about something fruity|0-1-midday-canal]]>><<set $player.drink to "Pimm's">><<set $player.money -= 8>><</button>> </p> <</nobr>><div style = "text-align: center;"> <h1>CHAPTER ONE</h1> <h2>THE INCIDENT</h2> <<button [[Continue|Intro]]>><</button>> </div><<nobr>> <<set $player.passage to passage()>> <p> <span class = "player">"I think I'll have a $player.drink,"</span><br><br> <<if $player.drink == "cider">> <span class = "sarah">"Ooh, good choice, I'll have the same,"</span> $sarah.name says. <<set $sarah.drink to "cider">><br><br> <<elseif $player.drink == "lager">> <span class = "sarah">"Ew, gross,"</span> $sarah.name says with a cheeky grin, <span class = "sarah">"I'll just stick to cider, thank you very much,"</span>.<<set $sarah.drink to "cider">><br><br> <span class = "player">"What's wrong with lager?"</span> you ask, narrowing your eyes at her slightly.<br><br> <span class = "sarah">"It tastes like sweaty trainers, I swear guys only drink it cause they're too scared to be seen as even the slightest bit feminine,"</span><br><br> You see an opportunity and dive straight on it, <span class = "player">"And you would know what sweaty trainers taste like?"</span><br><br> <span class = "sarah">"Hey!"</span> she hits you lightheartedly on the shoulder, <span class = "sarah">"Just order your sweaty trainer drink,"</span><br><br> <<else>> <span class = "sarah">"Ooh, nice, summer does mean Pimm's,"</span> $sarah.name grins at you, <span class = "sarah">"think I'll grab one too, it's just a shame we won't be able to get a pitcher,"</span><<set $sarah.drink to "Pimm's">><br><br> You consider asking her why you can't get a pitcher for a moment, but decide to let it slide. Clearly she's got some kind of plan, and you know that when she has a plan there's absolutely nothing that will change her mind.<br><br> <</if>> The two of you manage to order pretty quickly, despite how busy the bar is, thanks in no small part to $sarah.name's looks, you're sure. You both grab your plastic cups <<if $player.drink == "cider">> full of cider, <<elseif $player.drink == "lager">> and $sarah.name eyes yours with a look of mock disgust, <<else>> full of fruit filled gin, <</if>> before you head out into the beer garden. Unsurprisingly it's even more full than inside, the British public never able to miss an opportunity to drink in the sun.<br><br> Without missing a beat, $sarah.name starts to lead you through the beer garden, winding past tables and drunk pubgoers, towards the gate set in a low wall overlooking the canal. The wrought iron gate creaks as $sarah.name pushes it open, crying out for oil but nonetheless relenting and ushering the two of you onto a narrow staircase down to the bridleway.<br><br> Despite the very short distance from the pub, the bridleway is blessedly quiet, the noise of drunken conversations dying down as you descend to the water's edge. The only other people you can see down here are a few dog walkers back past the stairs, and a pair of teenagers looking rather sheepish up ahead.<br><br> $sarah.name nudges you with her elbow, <span class = "sarah">"Think they're on a date?"</span> she giggles, her voice low and conspiratorial.<br><br> You can't help but laugh along with her, nearly choking on your drink as you were mid sip, <span class = "sarah">"$sarah.name!"</span> you splutter.<br><br> <span class = "sarah">"What?"</span> she looks at you with the most innocent eyes she can muster, <span class = "sarah">"It's an honest question,"</span> <span class = "player"><i>They could say the same about us,</i></span> you think to yourself, <span class = "player">"Nevermind,"</span> you say out loud as the furtive teens hurry past you, their eyes averted.<br><br> <span class = "sarah">"Oh, come on, they so are,"</span> she laughs louder this time, <span class = "sarah">"Ah, young love,"</span> she says in her best wistful tone.<br><br> <span class = "player">"You're hopeless,"</span> you begin, <span class = "player">"Such a romant-"</span><br><br> A cacophonous sound from ahead cuts you off, ripping through the air. It was something like a peal of thunder and tearing fabric, and almost deafeningly loud. You raise your gaze, eyes wide, as you try to see, try to work out, what made that sound. And then the screams begin. At first scattered and disparate, but growing in number and volume. Full of terror and pain, they eminate from the streets above you, spreading out like a wave of fear. A wave that you get caught up in, freezing you to the spot as your heartbeat pounding in your ears and your brain refuses to function.<br><br> $sarah.name, however, seems entirely unaffected. She discards her half-drunk cup of $sarah.drink and starts off up the bridleway towards the next set of stairs. She shoots a quick glance back at you as she speeds away, <span class = "sarah">"Come on, $player.name! We have to help!"</span><br><br> <<button [[Follow after her|0-1-midday-incident-1]]>><</button>> </p> <</nobr>><<nobr>> <<set $player.passage to passage()>> <p> You don't know if it's the forcefulness of her voice, or the guilt at having been frozen in fear, but you take off after $sarah.name, discarding your own cup as you break into a sprint, <<if $player.drink == "Pimm's">> fruit and alcohol spilling onto the ground. <<else>> $player.drink spilling onto the ground. <</if>> She's already half-way up the stairs by the time you make it a few paces. Not wanting to lose her, or perhaps not wanting to get left behind, you redouble your pace, pushing yourself harder than you've done in ages as your breathing begins to match your pounding heart.<br><br> You take the stairs two at a time, being careful not to trip. Reaching the top, you stop for just a moment to catch your breath, glancing around to see where $sarah.name has gotten to. The narrow alley is packed with terrified people, each trying to get away from whatever the hell is going on; so packed that you can't see $sarah.name. There's nothing for it. You have to go on. You have to push through. Even though every fibre of your being is telling you to run. You have to find her.<br><br> You being to push your way through the crowd, forcing people aside as you call out her name. But every shout is swallowed by panicked screaming and the sound pounding feet as the mass of people stampede to any semblence of safety.<br><br> <span class = "player">"$sarah.name! $sarah.name! <span style = "text-transform: uppercase;">$sarah.name!</span>"</span> you cry out in vain as you manage to finally push through the throng and spill out from the alley. The wider street you emerge onto is mostly clear of people, but full of discarded detritis and bags left behind in the rush to escape. You turn this way and that, desparately trying to find you friend, to catch a glimpse of her. But again nothing. It's like she disappeared. Leaving you alone.<br><br> And then you see her. Not $sarah.name. But someone else. Someone you can barely tear your eyes off. She seems to glow, as if the sun itself is pouring out from her skin. Long black hair spills down her back, coiled into tight locs, and even that appeared to glow with otherworldly light. But it's what she held that draws your attention even more. Grasped in her right hand is a long spear, and in her left, a large round shield, as if she's some hoplite from ancient Greece. And her clothes match; she is dressed like an avenging warrior, bright silver cuirass sculpted with rippling muscles and emphasising her chest, with matching pteruges over a deep pink skirt. She looks like something out of a fantasy film, or an RPG.<br><br> /* art of eva */ She's standing in the middle of the street, calm and collected, directing people with her spear, <span class = "eva"><span style = "text-shadow: 0 0 10px black;"><i>"Get to the shopping centre, run!"</i></span></span> she calls out, her voice echoing around the walls and inside your mind.<br><br> You feel yourself begin to obey, without a second thought, turning and starting to run, your body moving before your mind has caught up. <span class = "player"><i>No! I need to find $sarah.name! I have to go back!</i></span> you yell at yourself within your head. But your legs refuse to listen, carrying you further and further away, towards the large glass doors of Chapelcross shopping centre.<br><br> As soon as you enter through the doors, your eyes fall upon the huddled masses. Their faces are masks of terror, and you aren't sure yours is any different from the way your heart is racing. A few are crying, some with loud sobs, others silently, just allowing the tears to roll down their cheeks. Most have found seating where they can, on benches or artificial planter boxes, or just sat on the floor. You see families hugging, a few individuals pacing, and throughout it all a tension that you could cut with a knife.<br><br> <span class = "player"><i>No, I can't be here, I need to go back and look for $sarah.name,</i></span> you turn back towards the door, but your feet refuse to move an inch, no matter how much you internally scream at them. You feel so helpless. So fucking helpless. You want to go find her. You need to go find her. But your body simply won't obey. There's nothing you can do. You want to scream. You want to rage. You want to cry. But instead you simply collapse, slumping down to the floor and hugging your knees into your chest.<br><br> <span class = "eva"><span style = "text-shadow: 0 0 10px black;"><i>"Everybody stay here, you'll be safe in here,"</i></span></span> you look up to see the woman from before, spear and shield still in hand, standing at the entrance. Once again you feel her voice permeating your mind, piercing through your fear and frustration and anger. Her words seem to calm your racing mind. You're safe in here. Safe here. Safe.<br><br> She paces further into the shopping centre, passing by terrified clusters of people, looking down upon them with pure compassion and kindness, <span class = "eva"><span style = "text-shadow: 0 0 10px black;"><i>"If anyone is hurt, bring them into the Boots,"</i></span></span> she gestures towards the shop with the tip of her spear, <span class = "eva">"I will be back shortl-,"</span><br><br> An earpiercing scream cuts through the building, followed by more and more. You turn and see people backing away from the doors in terror.<br><br> <<button [[Look to the doors|0-1-midday-incident-2]]>><</button>> </p> <</nobr>><<nobr>> <<set $player.passage to passage()>> <p> You turn your attention back to the glass doors, and immediately regret it. On the other side is some kind of creature. Inky black skin covers its rippling muscles. A carapace of large overlapping red crystaline plates covers its head, spine, and limbs. A single long, vicious claw protrudes from both of its front limbs, the other four clack against the paving slabs as it paces back and forth, eyeing the terrified people within. You watch as the thing's gaze darts from its prey to the spear-wielding woman. And then it opens its mouth. The creature's bottom jaw splits in half, forming two crushing mandibles lined with deadly sharp teeth. A thick tar-like substance oozes from its maw, dripping down to the ground and pooling beneth it. As you stare at it, you feel a sense of utter revulsion and terror. But beneath it, something else. At the back of your mind. Something inhuman. Something other.<br><br> /* art of lesser warrior riftspawn */ You shake your head, forcing your attention away from the strange sensation in your skull and back towards the thing. You swear you can hear a low growl eminating from its throat, like predatory cat about to pounce.<br><br> And then it does. It leaps forward, clawed limbs crashing through the glass and sending shards exploding inwards. It lands with a skitter as its claws scrabbled for purchase on the smooth tiles. Out of the corner of your eye you see someone fall as they desparately scramble away from the beast. You watch in frozen terror as the creature's eyes lock onto the fallen man, it's muscles tense as it sinks into a low crouch. It pounces. Time appears to slow as its powerful legs propel it into the air, directly at its hapless victim.<br><br> Then time seems to stop.<br><br> That otherworldly sensation returns in full force, piercing through your mind like an ice pick. Your skull pounds from within as the feeling coalesces. You can almost hear words in your mind, not your thoughts, but something else's. No, not words. Concepts. Ideas.<br><br> <span class = "well">Protect.</span><br><br> You try to ignore it, to force your attention back to the present. Back to the creature.<br><br> <span class = "well">Defend.</span><br><br> Images flash before your eyes. A pool of swirling water, beckoning you. A ruined temple.<br><br> <span class = "well">Join.</span><br><br> The open sky, crisscrossed with glowing strands of blue and gold that intertwine. A cave, deep below the earth.<br><br> <span class = "well">Become.</span><br><br> And then the images change and coalesce into a single one. A stark facility. Another swirling pool. And in front of it, a chained creature. Not the same as the one leaping through the air that you know is only metres away from you. It is shaped like an elongated white wolf with sparse fur and glistening skin.<br><br> A new voice appears in your head. An actual voice this time, not just concepts made thought. But broken and desperate. <span class = "shepherd">Deal....sign.....help..me........save......world.....save.....</span><br><br> And then it's gone. And in its place, a horrifying new sensation. You feel yourself being dragged down into swriling waters, pulled into their depths. The images return with full force. Faster and faster. Swirling water. Ruined temple. Glowing strands. Cave.<br><br> <span class = "well">Protect.</span><br><br> You feel the water reach your abdomen, as cold as ice. Swirling Water. Ruined temple. Strands. Cave.<br><br> <span class = "well">Save.</span><br><br> You try in vain to fight against the waters, but your limbs won't answer, won't move. Water. Temple. Strands. Cave.<br><br> <span class = "well">Protect. Join. Save. Become. Help.</span><br><br> The concepts are more forceful now as the water begins to submerge you entirely, pulling at your throat. You desperately try to suck in a breath before you dragged under entirely.Water. Beckoning. Pulling. Swirling. Power.<br><br> <span class = "well">Join. Save. Become. Defend. Strength. Protect. Power.</span><br><br> You feel the strength sapping from your mind as the alien thoughts bombard you. You have to fight it. You have to keep going. You have to find $sarah.name. You have to save her. You have to protect her.<br><br> You give in.<br><br> Your energy spent, you allow yourself to be pulled fully under the swirling waters.<br><br> <span class = "well">Joy.</span><br><br> You feel your vision begin to fade, the world around you and the images in your head fading to black.<br><br> <<button [[Sink|0-1-midday-incident-3]]>><</button>> </p> <</nobr>><<nobr>> <<set $player.passage to passage()>> <<set $player.channelInt += 1>> <p> Light returns to world. You blink hard and suck in a deep breath. The air stings your lungs. Your eyes dart around, tears streaming as the sudden light burns them.<br><br> <span class = "well">PROTECT!</span><br><br> Time seems to start again with a lurch, and without thinking, you spring upwards. You dart between the beast and its prey, arms raised in a boxing guard. You watch through your forearms as the creature arcs through the air. Directly towards you. You brace. Waiting for the thing to strike. Waiting to feels its terrible jaws clamp around you. Its teeth piercing your flesh. Its bite breaking your bone.<br><br> Your vision blurs as your muscles tense, awaiting the impact. Awaiting your fate. The beast's maw fills your vision. Dripping fangs and crushing jaws. And then the thing recoils. Thrown back as if by some invisible force. The blurring of your vision worsens, the creature fading into an indistinct shape as it falls to the floor.<br><br> No. Not your vision. Something in front of your vision. A circle. In front of your arms. No. Attached to your arms. No. Arm.<br><br> Your hands drop and the circle drops with them, following your left arm down to your side. And then you feel something. Sominthing in your right hand. Almost cylindrical. You shoot a glance downwards as the beast begins get back to its clawed feet. The object in your hand is long, almost sword-shaped, but blurry, its edges bleeding out into nothingness. You tear your eyes away as the thing gets unsteadily back to its feet. You move without conscious thought, acting entirely on instinct, swinging you right hand in a wide arc towards the creature. You put all your might behind it, willing the thing in your hand to cleave through the beast.<br><br> It makes contact. The impact reverberates down the weapon and into your death grip, jarring your hand. You watch in horror as it bounces off the crystaline carapace, leaving the beast unharmed. Panicking, you pull your left arm in front of you in a desperate attempt to protect yourself with the blurry shield, as the creature prepares to strike at you, raising a deadly claw. Once again you brace yourself the blow to land, but this time feeling woefully unprepared.<br><br> A sudden movement from your right catches your eye. A flash of light streaks across your vision. A spear. The woman.<br><br> The tip of the spear pierces clean through the creature's carapace, sinking into it's flesh. The beast recoils, attmpting to get away, but the woman doesn't let up, withdrawing the spear and striking again and again until the thing collapses to the floor. Dead.<br><br> You breathe a sigh of relief, collapsing to the ground in exhaustion as the sword and shield dissapate, vanishing into nothing.<br><br> <span class = "player"><i>What the hell just happened?! What the fuck was that thing?!</i></span> questions race through your mind as you try to make sense of everything. For some reason your brain didn't question the woman with her spear and shield before now. But now. Now everything seems wrong. Everything-<br><br> A sudden sharp pain pierces your throat. You look down. The woman has her spear under your chin, the tip pricking your skin and drawing a bead of blood.<br><br> /* art of eva with spear to mc's throat, dead riftspawn in background */ <span class = "eva">"Who are you?"</span> she asks with a growl. The care and compassion now entirely gone from her voice.<br><br> <span class = "player">"I-I'm $player.name,"</span> you stammer out, not believing what is happening. She just saved you. Hell, you just saved that man. You still have no idea how, but you did. And now she's holding you at spear-point.<br><br> She looks you up and down, <span class = "eva">"<i>What</i> are you?"</span><br><br> <span class = "player">"I'm a-a student,"</span> you manage.<br><br> A long moment passes as she stands stationary, eyes darting up and down your body. Then, thankfully, she releases you, withdrawing her spear from your neck. You breathe a sigh of relief, <span class = "player">"Thank you-"</span><br><br> You watch as the spear evaporates into thin air, leaving behind glowing wisps that swirl and disintigrate. Her hand is on your forehead and-<br><br> <<button [[Everything goes black|0-1-afternoon-safehouse-1]]>><<set $time.period += 1>><</button>> </p> <</nobr>><<nobr>> <<set $player.passage to passage()>> <<set $time.dayName to "???">> <<set $time.periodName to "">> <p> You slowly begin to come to, your head pounding like the worst hangover imaginable. You've clearly been unceremoniously dumped onto a cold, hard floor, finding yourself lying on your side. Blinking your bleary eyes you try in vain to force them to focus, but they simply refuse, leaving you with nothing but blurry outlines of shapes that you can barely make out. At least your ears are working fine.<br><br> <span class = "eva">"Sh- they? <i>He</i> is a channeler,"</span> the voice is eerily familiar, but this time it's calmer and, thankfully, not reverberating within your mind.<br><br> <span class = "niks">"That's not possible,"</span> a second feminine voice speaks up, <span class = "niks">"Are you sure, <span id = "evaNameBox"> <span class = "tooltip"> <<link "$eva.name">> <<replace "#evaNameBox">> <<textbox "$eva.name" $eva.name>> <<link "OK">> <<replace "#evaNameBox">> $eva.name <</replace>> <<replace "#evaName">> $eva.name <</replace>> <</link>> <</replace>> <</link>> <span class = "tooltiptext">Click to change $eva.name's name.</span></span> </span> ?"</span> the second voice is cool, almost detached, and eminating from further away, somewhere to your left.<br><br> <span class = "eva">"I'm not lying,"</span> the hoplite woman, <span id = "evaName">$eva.name</span> apparently, raises her voice, slightly irate, <span class = "eva">"I saw what I saw, he channeled a shield and some kind of sword, and held off a lesser warrior,"</span> well at least you know what that thing is called now. Or at least what these strange people who have kidnapped you call it.<br><br> <span class = "niks">"Okay, but <i>he</i> is a guy, men can't channel, not to mention the fact he has no gem, and clearly has had no training,"</span> the second voice says, in a very matter-of-fact way, as if what she's saying is common knowledge, <span class = "niks">"So like I said, impossible,"</span><br><br> <span class = "kaja">" <span id = "niksNameBox"> <span class = "tooltip"> <<link "$niks.name">> <<replace "#niksNameBox">> <<textbox "$niks.name" $niks.name>> <<link "OK">> <<replace "#niksNameBox">> $niks.name <</replace>> <<replace "#niksName">> $niks.name <</replace>> <</link>> <</replace>> <</link>> <span class = "tooltiptext">Click to change $niks.name's name.</span></span> </span> , if <span id = "evaName">$eva.name</span> says that's what she saw, then that's what she saw,"</span> this new voice sounded older, still feminine like the other two, but wiser, <span class = "kaja">"and we can test this one,"</span><br><br> The second person, <span id = niksName>$niks.name</span>, sighs, <span class = "niks">"Okay, but it <i>should</i> be impossible,"</span><br><br> <span class = "tara">"What matters is what we do with him,"</span> the new voice is uncomfortably close, and you flinch away instinctively, turning in the direction of the sudden sound so close to your ear.<br><br> <span class = "kaja">"Looks like he's awake,"</span> the older voice says, <span class = "kaja">"<span id = "evaName">$eva.name</span>, if you wouldn't mind doing the honours,"</span><br><br> <span class = "eva">"Yes, Mother,"</span> one of the blurry figures gets closer and closer. A panic starts to rise in your chest. What exactly is she going to do? What are the honours? She's already knocked you unconscious and kidnapped you, what is going to do now?. You'd really rather not find out.<br><br> You have to get away, to escape, to get the hell out of here. You aren't sure what you're planning to do with blurry eyes and a pounding head, but anything is better than nothing. You start to scrabble backwards, trying to put some distance between you and her, to give yourself time to think, time to act. There's a sickening crack as your head collides with something hard - and a moment later, pain. The pain radiates out from the back of your skull, adding to your already pounding headache. Clutching your head, you collapse into a heap.<br><br> <span class = "eva">"Easy there, try not to injure yourself any more,"</span> Eva's voice is paradoxically soothing even though she caused this whole mess by abducting you in the first place, <span class = "eva">"I'm just going to undo the sleeping magik,"</span> sleeping magik? That's what she's calling it? It feels like you've been beaten about the head with a bat, and that was before you just cracked your skull against what you presume is a wall.<br><br> You relent, resigning yourself to whatever she wants to do to you. You flinch as you feel her hands against the sides of your head. Not that the touch is hard or aggressive. No, it's actually careful and gentle. But even so, the sudden sensation of someone's hands on you while you can barely see is somewhat terrifying.<br><br> Eva mutters something under her breath, words that you can't quite make out. You're not even sure if they are words at all. But whatever she's doing, it seems to be working. Your eyes slowly begin to focus again, and the pounding in your head begins to subside, fading away until all that is left is the memory of the pain. It does not, however, do anything for the pain from bashing your skull.<br><br> As your eyes return to functioning, the shape of <span id = "evaName">$eva.name</span> starts to resolve in front of you. Her dark face is adorned with a caring smile, the kind you might give to a child who's grazed their knee. She doesn't look like the hero of myth like before, no longer armed and armoured, instead she's wearing a simple pink tank top and grey trackies, looking for all the world like an ordinary person and not at all like a fantasy warrior. Only now, with <span id = "evaName">$eva.name</span>'s face so close to yours, do you notice a jagged scar running across her right cheek, ending just below the corner of her mouth.<br><br> <span class = "eva">"There,"</span> she says, rising to her feet and softly padding away.<br><br> <<button [[Take a look around the room|0-1-afternoon-safehouse-2]]>><</button>> </p> <</nobr>><<nobr>> <div class = "textCont"> Other person <div class = "textFirst">This is an example text message</div> <div class = "text">this is a follow-on text from the same person</div> </div> <div class = "textReplyCont"> <div style = "line-height: 60%;">You</div> <div class = "textReplyFirst">And this is the reply from you</div> <div class = "textReply">this is your follow-on text what if I just wrote shit tonnes of text here to make it bigger and bigger</div> </div> <</nobr>> [[Start]] <<nobr>> <<set $player.passage to passage()>> <<set $time.dayName to "???">> <<set $time.periodName to "">> <<set $eva.met = true>> <<set $kaja.met = true>> <p> You lift your head and finally manage to get a look at your surroundings. The octagonal room cold and bare, grey tiled floor and unpainted concrete walls. Although you do notice some markings on each flat section of wall, comprised of strange glyphs painted onto the bare concrete in a glittering blue, arranged into archways, some fresh and new, others old and fading. Some even appear to be painted over older markings, as you can make out some barely visible glyphs beneath the fresher ones. Or at least most of them are painted on, one of them appears to be made from sparkling blue crystals inset into the wall; they seem to radiate power, giving off a faint light that pulsates gently. Set into one of the wall sections to your left is a simple wooden door, almost out of place in its mundanity against the strangeness of the rest of the room, it's painted an off-white and looks exactly like one you might find in any rental property up and down the country.<br><br> $eva.name is now standing with her back to you, having a hushed conversation with an older woman in the middle of the room. That must be the one she called Mother, and she definitely looks the part: an older woman of maybe fifty or sixty years, her face is wrinkled with time and crossed by a number of scars. Stood nestled in one of the many corners is a young woman, possibly not much older than you are, she has her arms crossed leaning against a wall, gazing at you with a surly expression tinged with curiosity, a long blonde braid falling over her shoulder. You lock eyes accidentally, and immediately shy from her piercing gaze, flinching away and averting your eyes.<br><br> <span class = "kaja">"Well, it's time we tested you, $player.name isn't it?"</span> the older woman, 'Mother', approaches you, her long strides oozing confidence.<br><br> <span class = "player">"Er, yes,"</span> you manage, tripping over your tongue slightly.<br><br> <span class = "kaja">"Good, you may call me <span id = "kajaNameBox"> <span class = "tooltip"> <<link "$kaja.name">> <<replace "#kajaNameBox">> <<textbox "$kaja.name" $kaja.name>> <<link "OK">> <<replace "#kajaNameBox">> $kaja.name <</replace>> <</link>> <</replace>> <</link>> <span class = "tooltiptext">Click to change $kaja.name's name.</span></span> </span> follow me,"</span> she says, turning on her heel, before turning her head back to look at you, <span class = "kaja">"$eva.name would like to watch, would that be okay with you?"</span><br><br> That's the first time any of them have actually asked for your consent for anything.<br><br> <<button [['"Okay,"'|0-1-afternoon-test-1-eva]]>><<set $eva.rel += 1>><<notify 5s>>$eva.name Relationship Up<</notify>><</button>><br><br> <<button [[Shake your head|0-1-afternoon-test-1-no]]>><</button>> </p> <</nobr>><<nobr>> <<set $player.passage to passage()>> <<set $time.dayName to "???">> <<set $time.periodName to "">> <<set $eva.met to true>><<set $kaja.met to true>> <p> You warily get to your feet, afraid they might give out at any moment, and follow $kaja.name out of the strange octagonal room. The surly girl in corner keeps her eyes on you the entire time, observing you like some specimen in a lab. $eva.name claps happily and files out after you, following quite a distance behind, as if you are a skittish animal she is afraid to spook.<br><br> As you cross the threshold, you realise for the first time that you're underground, before you stands a narrow stone staircase climbing up to an aged wooden door. You take the steps carefully, not your usual two-at-a-time bound, but careful step by careful step, cautious not to trip and fall and give yourself any more cranial trauma.<br><br> $kaja.name leads you out into corridor that looks like it could belong to any office building, magnlolia walls and ceiling tiles yellowing with age. It feels like you've been deposited into another world. Again. From the terror of whatever the hell was happening in town, to confonting the <i>thing</i> in the shopping centre, to waking up in a strange room covered with glyphs, and now this: sudden boring mundanity. The sight of it stops you in your tracks for just a moment. The sound of $eva.name's footfalls behind you stop. She's still being careful not to get too close. $kaja.name doesn't seem to notice, coninuing onwards down the corridor with her slow but confident gait. Anxious not to be left behind, you take a few hurried paces to close the distance a little.<br><br> She leads you past a four rooms flanking the corridor with numbers stuck on their doors, the kind that you'd find on cheaper uni accomodation. It's clear each room has been renumbered countless times, the ghost of glue from numbers past visible beneath the current numbers. You note each one as you pass. 35. 36. 37. 39. Wait, what happened to 38? And there's no way there are 39 rooms along this corridor or the entire floor. Clearly they relate to something, but you have no idea what.<br><br> At last, $kaja.name stops in front of a nondescript door to the right, she shoots a quick look back at you to make sure you are still following, before pulling the door open and holding it, waiting for you. You approach with trepidation, worried about what exactly this "test" of hers is going to entail. But still, it's not like you have any other option. These strange women have kidnapped you and brought you to some strange building. You have no idea where you even are. You don't know how you'd get out of this building. Even if you did call the police.... shit, your phone! You stop and pat your pocket, hoping to feel the reasuring shape of the intelligent rectangle. But there's nothing there. Fuck. Your phone's gone and you've only just noticed. Fuck. Your one connection with the outside world and it's gone. You've not been without the damn thing since you got it. You even have it with you in exams, albeit switched off.<br><br> And then you notice something else. Your bag. Your bag is missing too. You didn't see it in the basement room. It's definitely not on your back. It's got all your cards in it, your ID, your keys. So even if you did get out of here, you'd have no way of getting home, and no way of unlocking your bedroom door even if you did manage to get there. That's if you're still in the country. Given you have no idea what time it actually is, or even what day. Fuck. You're really in the shit here.<br><br> <span class = "kaja">"If you're wondering where your belongs are, don't worry, they are safe,"</span> $kaja.name notices you obviously panicking about your stuff, although her words don't exactly help very much. You feel like you're about three minutes or one minor inconvenience away from spiralling and collapsing into a ball on the floor. <span class = "kaja">"Now if you don't mind, we don't have all day,"</span> she gestures to the open doorway.<br><br> You guess you have no choice.<br><br> <<button [[Enter the room|0-1-afternoon-test-2-eva]]>><</button>> </p> <</nobr>><<nobr>> <<set $player.passage to passage()>> <<set $time.dayName to "???">> <<set $time.periodName to "">> <<set $eva.met to true>><<set $kaja.met to true>> <p> You warily get to your feet, afraid they might give out at any moment, and follow $kaja.name out of the strange octagonal room. The surly girl in corner keeps her eyes on you the entire time, observing you like some specimen in a lab. You glance over in $eva.name's direction, she looks pretty disappointed, staring at the ground in front of her with slumped shoulders. Seems like she did really want to watch. But as much as they're treating you like one, you are <i>not</i> a science experiment.<br><br> As you cross the threshold, you realise for the first time that you're underground, before you stands a narrow stone staircase climbing up to an aged wooden door. You bring all the memories together in your head, trying to force yourself to connect with whatever this well thing is, trying to follow $kaja.name's instructions. Water. Images. Voice. You remember the confusion, the headache, the fear. Water. Images. Voice. You remember diving in the way of the fallen man, protecting him from the creature. Water. Images. Voice. You remember the way the water sucked you in, dragging you deeper. Water. Images. Voice. You picture the swirling water, the ruins, the glowing motes in the air. Water. Images. Voice. You conjure to mind the concepts the voice spoke to you. Water. Images. Voice. You try. You <i>try</i>. You <i><b>try</b></i>.<br><br> But nothing happens.<br><br> As much as you try to force yourself, to connect with this thing, to channel that same power you felt, nothing happens.<br><br> You release a breath you didn't know you were holding, <span class = "player">"It's no use, I can't do it,"</span> you say, defeated.<br><br> You glance at $kaja.name, then to $eva.name's reflection. $kaja.name looks pensive. $eva.name looks disappointed.<br><br> <span class = "kaja">"Hmm,"</span> $kaja.name looks off to the side, deep in thought, <span class = "kaja">"When we instruct the novices, we teach them mantras..."</span> she trails off.<br><br> You watch her face as if it would give something away, but it is all but unreadable. She is clearly pondering, but you have no idea if she has an answer, no idea if she knows how to make this work.<br><br> And then, <span class = "kaja">"Sit down,"</span> she says calmly, gesturing to the sprung wooden floor.<br><br> You hesitate for a second. How will sitting down help? Maybe because you were sat down when it first happened? That can't be it, right?<br><br> $kaja.name simply watches you, waiting. You decide to oblige her, sinking down to the floor.<br><br> <span class = "kaja">"Find a position that is comfortable,"</span> $kaja.name says, joining you on the floor, directly in front of you, <span class = "kaja">"Close your eyes and focus on your breathing, counting each breath in and out, up to ten,"</span> she takes a deep breath as if to demonstrate, <span class = "kaja">"In, one,"</span> she lets the breath out again, slow and steady, <span class = "kaja">"two,"</span><br><br> You allow your eyes to fall shut and follow suit. In, one. Out, two. In, three. Out, four. In, five.<br><br> <span class = "kaja">"Focus on your breathing, let every other thought gently drift away,"</span> her voice is soothing, <span class = "kaja">"Keep focus on your breathing, but follow my voice, let my words guide you,"</span><br><br> Out, six. In, seven. Out, eight.<br><br> <span class = "kaja">"Let your muscles relax, start with your toes, realease any tension,"</span> in, nine. Out, ten. <span class = "kaja">"Then your feet, let the rest on the floor,"</span> in, one. <span class = "kaja">"Moving up through your legs, relax your calves, your thighs,"</span> out, two. <span class = "kaja">"Up through your stomach, feel your diaphragm move as you breathe,"</span> in, three. <span class = "kaja">"Let your shoulders drop, releasing any tension from them,"</span> out, four. <span class = "kaja">"Allow you arms to rest on your legs,"</span> in, five.<br><br> You feel yourself begin to sink into the relaxation, letting go of all the tension and the fear that has built up.<br><br> <span class = "kaja">"Now picture yourself at the top of a small flight of stairs, just three steps,"</span> you do as she says, almost subconsciously, <span class = "kaja">"Take the first step down, feel your thoughts drifting away, leaving your mind quiet,"</span> you quiet your conscious mind, not forcefully, just following her voice. You almost feel as though there's something else to her words, something beneath them, soothing your soul, <span class = "kaja">"Now the second step, you're beginning to drift further and further away,"</span> you feel your head nodding and you let it, chin falling against your chest, <span class = "kaja">"The third step, the only thing you know is my voice, listen to my voice, follow my voice, let my voice guide you,"</span> you sink deeper. There is only $kaja.name's voice. There is nothing else. Just her voice.<br><br> <span class = "kaja">"There were words, concepts, allow them to return to you, let them repeat in your head,"</span><br><br> Join. Save. Become. Defend. Strength. Protect. Power. The words enter your mind without conscious effort, as if they were always there, just below the surface. Join. Save. Become. Defend. Strength. Protect. Power. You begin to feel something, deep within your chest, something golden, blossoming outward. Join. Save. Become. Defend. Strength. Protect. Power. The feeling of golden light flows through you, spreading from your solar plexus. Join. Save. Become. Defend. Strength. Protect. Power. It flows down your abdomen, into your legs. Join. Save. Become. Defend. Strength. Protect. Power. Up your chest, your shoulders, your arms. Join. Save. Become. Defend. Strength. Protect. Power. It tingles with energy. Join. Save. Become. Defend. Strength. Protect. Power.<br><br> <span class = "kaja">"Good, hold onto that,"</span> $kaja.name's voice is steady, soothing, calm. But your subconscious picks up on something else. It sounds like she's smiling, <span class = "kaja">"Focus on this feeling, this is your centre, your locus of power, your gemstone,"</span><br><br> This feeling, this tingling golden energy, cements itself into your memory, growing roots and blooming.<br><br> A squeak from behind you drags you out of your trance-like state. Not all the way, but just enough that your conscious brain starts to re-assert iteself. The golden feeling begins to fade.<br><br> <span class = "kaja">"Okay, you are becoming more aware, coming back to the world. You're waking up, taking the steps back up. You slowly open your eyes, letting the light of the room in again.<br><br> The first thing you notice is $kaja.name in front of you, smiling contentedly. Then your eyes catch $eva.name in the mirror. She's bouncing on her toes, a wide grin on her face. As soon as she notices you are fully back in the room, she claps and bounds up to you.<br><br> <span class = "eva">"You did it!"</span> she exclaims, jubilantly, <span class = "eva">"$player.name! But it grows. Slowly. Ever so slowly. It grows, blooming into that tingling golden energy, spreading outwards, little by little. As you feel it start to spread down your eyes, you begin to picture the sword and the shield, your hands clenching slightly, as if they were already gripping them. And then you feel it. You're <i>doing</i> it.<br><br> <span class = "kaja">"Good, good, hold onto this, not too tightly, but just enough,"</span> $kaja.name's voice feels secure, like an anchor, holding you in the present.<br><br> <<button [[Look at yourself in the mirror|0-1-afternoon-test-4-eva]]>><</button>> </p> <</nobr>><<nobr>> <<set $player.passage to passage()>> <p> You step out from the dim flourescent lighting of the sweaty lecture theatre, blinking against the blazing September sun. The unfortunate thing, for your eyes at least, is that there's not a cloud in the sky, giving the sun free rein to burn your retinas. Sticking your hand into the pocket of your jeans, you withdraw your sunglasses and haphazardly shove them onto your face. At last, some relief.<br><br> You look around at your fellow freshers. Most look worse for wear, trudging along under the oppressive sun, shades on, eyes glued to the floor in front of them as if the ground was at risk of falling away under their feet. Clearly they're all nursing some pretty dreadful hangovers. Thankfully, your new found friends, or one of them at least, is more sensible than you would have otherwise been and made sure the three of you were having water in between each drink, and insisted on getting back to the flat fairly early to beat the takeaway rush. Thank fuck for sensible friends. Although, if you don't get absolutely plastered on freshers week and spend the next day wishing you were dead, are you really doing it right?<br><br> Speak of the devil, you notice your friend <span id = "sarahNameBox"> <span class = "tooltip"> <<link "$sarah.name">> <<replace "#sarahNameBox">> <<textbox "$sarah.name" $sarah.name>> <<link "OK">> <<replace "#sarahNameBox">> $sarah.name <</replace>> <<replace "#sarahName">> $sarah.name <</replace>> <</link>> <</replace>> <</link>> <span class = "tooltiptext">Click to change $sarah.name's name.</span></span> </span> appearing at your right shoulder. Your phone buzzes again.<br><br> <span class = "sarah">" <span id = "louisNameBox"> <span class = "tooltip"> <<link "$louis.name">> <<replace "#louisNameBox">> <<textbox "$louis.name" $louis.name>> <<link "OK">> <<replace "#louisNameBox">> $louis.name <</replace>> <<replace "#louisName">> $louis.name <</replace>> <</link>> <</replace>> <</link>> <span class = "tooltiptext">Click to change Louis' name.</span></span> </span> said he's gonna check out freshers fair, but he'll meet us before the pub crawl tonight,"</span> one of the first things the three of you did after meeting each other and hitting it off was make a group chat. Turns out being a year, or two in the case of <span id = "sarahName">$sarah.name</span>, older than the rest of the freshers and showing up early is a fastrack to friendship.<br><br> <span class = "sarah">"You wanna head into town for a bit? Go have a look around?"</span><br><br> The two of you decided to check it out on Sunday while $louis.name was nursing a hangover in bed, and neither of you particularly fancy going back to the sweltering sports hall packed with noisy freshers to be bombarded with flyers and coupons.<br><br> <span class = "player">"Sure,"</span> you say, turning to head down the steps towards the bus stop.<br><br> <span class = "sarah">"Cool,"</span> $sarah.name bounds in front of you, taking the stairs two at a time, her ponytail swinging to and fro. You follow her down, taking the steps at a more sedate pace. A moment later, she triumphantly brandishing a stick of light pink deodorant decorated with winding flowers. $sarah.name shoves her hand up her top and deftly rolls on the deodorant, before looking up and catching your eye, <span class = "sarah">"Want some?"</span><br><br> You roll your eyes at her, you might not smell great about now, but that doesn't mean you want to smell like a girl.<br><br> <span class = "sarah">"Come on, you're not scared of a little deodorant are you?"</span> she grins cheekily, <span class = "sarah">"What, you worried you'll smell like a girl?"</span> $sarah.name laughs, brandishing the stick in your direction, <span class = "sarah">"It's barely even scented, see,"</span> she shoves the deodorant directly under your nose.<br><br> You give it a tentative sniff. The shield is medium-sized and round, maybe <span class = "tooltip"> 50cm<br><br> <span class = "tooltiptext"> about 20in </span> </span> in diameter; you can make out a slight convexity to it. Your eyes focus on the sword, or at least they try to, it is admittedly a bit difficult with the way it seems permanently out of focus, edges bleading out into the air. What you can make out is the blade looks to be about <span class = "tooltip"> 95cm<br><br> <span class = "tooltiptext"> about 37in </span> </span> in length, and at its base there is the hint of a crossguard.<br><br> This is so strange. Before everything that happened in town, you would have said that this was impossible, pure fantasy, but you can't deny what your eyes are telling you, what you have seen. It feels simultaneously like a strange dream and like it's too real. You keep expecting to wake up, to find yourself in your own bed, to grab breakfast in the kitchen with $sarah.name and $louis.name, to continue your normal life as a normal guy. But looking in the mirror, you worry that that is what is truly impossible now.<br><br> Your eyes flick over to the reflection of $eva.name in the mirror. She's taken a few steps forward into the room and is beaming, her eyes glinting with vindication and joy.<br><br> You take a few tentative steps closer to mirror, $kaja.name watching you with satisfied interest as you move. You thought you might have noticed something before, that same blurry light over your chest. As you draw closer you realise you definitely didn't imagine it. It's there. Blurry, unfocused, but there. Like some kind of breastplate, curving out to cover your chest.<br><br> And then you notice something else.<br><br> Your hair, normally shaggy and unkempt, looks...longer? Not by much, probably not enough that anyone else would notice. But enough for you. Enough for you to spot the difference. Not only that, but it looks somehow sleeker, with a slight sheen to it, like you're one of those models in a shampoo advert.<br><br> But that's not all. Your face looks different too, softer, gentler. Your cheekbones look slightly more pronounced, eyes a bit wider, nose smaller. Even your lips seem to have changed, they look fuller. Not big by any stretch, but just a bit plumper.<br><br> <<do tag "choice1">> <<if _choice1 == 1>> You shake your head. This is wrong. This is so wrong. That's not you. You don't look like that. This weird magic shit did that. It's not you.<br><br> You look away from the mirror, feeling the golden energy fade as you do, the sensation of the sword and shield and breastplate dissipating.<br><br> <span class = "player">"What the hell did you do to me?!"</span> you round on $kaja.name, glaring at her.<br><br> Confusion flashes across her face for a second, before it settles back into an unreadable expression, <span class = "kaja">"I didn't do anything, that was all you,"</span><br><br> <span class = "player">"No, you did something, you made me look...different,"</span><br><br> <span class = "kaja">"Ah,"</span> she begins, her eyes shifting into that caring gaze, <span class = "kaja">"well when we channel our powers, there are a few subtle changes to our appearance,"</span> she says, as if that explains everything.<br><br> <span class = "player">"But it didn't look like me,"</span> you gesture at the mirror, <span class = "player">"<i>I</i> didn't look like me,"</span><br><br> <span class = "kaja">"Seems like we're done here,"</span> $kaja.name ignores your protests, <span class = "kaja">"We should return to the others, we need to discuss this,"</span><br><br> <span class = "player">"But-"</span> you begin, but $kaja.name already has her back to you, walking towards the door that $eva.name now holds open.<br><br> <<button [[Return to the others|0-1-afternoon-deciding-1]]>><</button>> <<elseif _choice1 == 2>> You can't help but study yourself further, your eyes feel glued to your reflection as you turn your head slightly, getting a look at yourself from different angles. You bring all the memories together in your head, trying to force yourself to connect with whatever this well thing is, trying to follow $kaja.name's instructions. Water. Images. Voice. You remember the confusion, the headache, the fear. Water. Images. Voice. You remember diving in the way of the fallen man, protecting him from the creature. Water. Images. Voice. You remember the way the water sucked you in, dragging you deeper. Water. Images. Voice. You picture the swirling water, the ruins, the glowing motes in the air. Water. Images. Voice. You conjure to mind the concepts the voice spoke to you. Water. Images. Voice. You try. You <i>try</i>. You <i><b>try</b></i>.<br><br> But nothing happens.<br><br> As much as you try to force yourself, to connect with this thing, to channel that same power you felt, nothing happens.<br><br> You release a breath you didn't know you were holding, <span class = "player">"It's no use, I can't do it,"</span> you say, defeated.<br><br> You glance at $kaja.name, then to $eva.name's reflection. $kaja.name looks pensive. $eva.name looks disappointed.<br><br> <span class = "kaja">"Hmm,"</span> $kaja.name looks off to the side, deep in thought, <span class = "kaja">"When we instruct the novices, we teach them mantras..."</span> she trails off.<br><br> You watch her face as if it would give something away, but it is all but unreadable. She is clearly pondering, but you have no idea if she has an answer, no idea if she knows how to make this work.<br><br> And then, <span class = "kaja">"Sit down,"</span> she says calmly, gesturing to the sprung wooden floor.<br><br> You hesitate for a second. How will sitting down help? Maybe because you were sat down when it first happened? That can't be it, right?<br><br> $kaja.name simply watches you, waiting. You decide to oblige her, sinking down to the floor.<br><br> <span class = "kaja">"Find a position that is comfortable,"</span> $kaja.name says, joining you on the floor, directly in front of you, <span class = "kaja">"Close your eyes and focus on your breathing, counting each breath in and out, up to ten,"</span> she takes a deep breath as if to demonstrate, <span class = "kaja">"In, one,"</span> she lets the breath out again, slow and steady, <span class = "kaja">"two,"</span><br><br> You allow your eyes to fall shut and follow suit. In, one. Out, two. In, three. Out, four. In, five.<br><br> <span class = "kaja">"Focus on your breathing, let every other thought gently drift away,"</span> her voice is soothing, <span class = "kaja">"Keep focus on your breathing, but follow my voice, let my words guide you,"</span><br><br> Out, six. In, seven. Out, eight.<br><br> <span class = "kaja">"Let your muscles relax, start with your toes, realease any tension,"</span> in, nine. Out, ten. <span class = "kaja">"Then your feet, let the rest on the floor,"</span> in, one. <span class = "kaja">"Moving up through your legs, relax your calves, your thighs,"</span> out, two. <span class = "kaja">"Up through your stomach, feel your diaphragm move as you breathe,"</span> in, three. <span class = "kaja">"Let your shoulders drop, releasing any tension from them,"</span> out, four. <span class = "kaja">"Allow you arms to rest on your legs,"</span> in, five.<br><br> You feel yourself begin to sink into the relaxation, letting go of all the tension and the fear that has built up.<br><br> <span class = "kaja">"Now picture yourself at the top of a small flight of stairs, just three steps,"</span> you do as she says, almost subconsciously, <span class = "kaja">"Take the first step down, feel your thoughts drifting away, leaving your mind quiet,"</span> you quiet your conscious mind, not forcefully, just following her voice. You almost feel as though there's something else to her words, something beneath them, soothing your soul, <span class = "kaja">"Now the second step, you're beginning to drift further and further away,"</span> you feel your head nodding and you let it, chin falling against your chest, <span class = "kaja">"The third step, the only thing you know is my voice, listen to my voice, follow my voice, let my voice guide you,"</span> you sink deeper. There is only $kaja.name's voice. There is nothing else. Just her voice.<br><br> <span class = "kaja">"There were words, concepts, allow them to return to you, let them repeat in your head,"</span><br><br> Join. Save. Become. Defend. Strength. Protect. Power. The words enter your mind without conscious effort, as if they were always there, just below the surface. Join. Save. Become. Defend. Strength. Protect. Power. You begin to feel something, deep within your chest, something golden, blossoming outward. Join. Save. Become. Defend. Strength. Protect. Power. The feeling of golden light flows through you, spreading from your solar plexus. Join. Save. Become. Defend. Strength. Protect. Power. It flows down your abdomen, into your legs. Join. Save. Become. Defend. Strength. Protect. Power. Up your chest, your shoulders, your arms. Join. Save. Become. Defend. Strength. Protect. Power. It tingles with energy. Join. Save. Become. Defend. Strength. Protect. Power.<br><br> <span class = "kaja">"Good, hold onto that,"</span> $kaja.name's voice is steady, soothing, calm. But your subconscious picks up on something else. It sounds like she's smiling, <span class = "kaja">"Focus on this feeling, this is your centre, your locus of power, your gemstone,"</span><br><br> This feeling, this tingling golden energy, cements itself into your memory, growing roots and blooming.<br><br> <span class = "kaja">"Okay, good, let yourself become more aware. You're waking up, taking the steps back up. One, your conscious mind is beginning to wake up again. Two, you are becoming more aware of the sounds around you. Three, you are slowly becoming fully aware. You can open your eyes slowly if you want,"</span><br><br> You feel yourself being lifted out of the golden haze, coming back to reality as the feeling fades. You slowly open your eyes, letting the light of the room in again.<br><br> The first thing you notice is $kaja.name in front of you, smiling contentedly, her eyes kind <span class = "kaja">"That was good, we have proved you are a channeller. Now for the next step, are you ready?"</span> she words it like a question, but it really feels like it isn't one.<br><br> <span class = "player">"Er, yeah, I think so,"</span> you say, even though you aren't really sure.<br><br> <span class = "kaja">"Good, stand up,"</span> $kaja.name gets to her feet, her movements sure and steady and graceful. She reaches a door on her left and stops, you can hear the muffled sounds of conversation from within, managing to pick out at least two voices.<br><br> $kaja.name turns back to look at you, <span class = "kaja">"This might get heated, but you deserve to listen,"</span> her voice is very matter-of-fact, as if stating the obvious.<br><br> You aren't exactly sure you're ready for heated, aren't sure what heated looks like when magically empowered women are involved. There's a large plush corner sofa where the surly blonde girl from the cellar plays a shooter on a large flatscreen TV, and a few comfortable looking armchairs occupied by two other women. One is decidedly muscular and looks maybe a little older than the others, her brown hair kept in a short, neat pixie cut, her expression is one of seriousness; the other looks more laid back, sprawled over the chair with one leg resting over one of the arms, her bright red hair spilling over her shoulders. <<if not hasVisited("0-1-afternoon-test-1-eva")>> You notice $eva.name sitting off to one side, her anxious energy evident from where you are stood: her leg bounces rapidly, and she's picking at the hem of her top. <<else>> $eva.name enters behind you, still grinning. You let out a breath you didn't know you were holding. It comes out shaky and timid. Carefully walking around the sofa, you try to keep as much distance as you can between yourself and the piercing eyes of the two girls.<br><br> <<button [[Sit and listen|0-1-afternoon-deciding-2]]>><</button>> </p> <</nobr>><<nobr>> <<set $player.passage to passage()>> <<set $time.dayName to "???">> <<set $time.periodName to "">> <p> /* art of all the characters sat around the living room from perspective of mc */ <span class = "kaja">"We have tested $player.name,"</span> $kaja.name gestures at you, <span class = "kaja">"and confirmed he <i>is</i> a channeller,"</span> she pauses, letting the news sink in.<br><br> <<if hasVisited("0-1-afternoon-test-1-eva")>> Of course $eva.name already knows, <<else>> $eva.name looks up, her leg stops bouncing and her hands fall still, <</if>> <span class = "eva">"I told you!"</span> she says with a smug grin.<br><br> $niks.name rolls her eyes at her and puts a hand to her mouth, deep in thought. You look over at the other two, $beth.nick looks as guarded as before, her eyes still holding some suspicion; $tara.name simply smiles slightly.<br><br> <span class = "eva">"So we have to tell the Institute, right?"</span> $eva.name says, excitedly, <span class = "kaja">"I mean this is unheard of, a male channeller,"</span><br><br> <span class = "niks">"I'm with $eva.name,"</span> $niks.name speaks up, her tone level and matter-of-fact, <span class = "niks">"we don't know what we're dealing with here,"</span><br><br> $kaja.name furrows her brows, <span class = "kaja">"I do not think that is a good idea,"</span> she pauses momentarily, fixing her gaze on $niks.name, <span class = "kaja">"the Institute will take him, and it's one thing for us to disappear, but he is a civilian, it would be cruel to tear him away from his life completely,"</span><br><br> You honestly didn't expect $kaja.name to speak up for you like that. You've spent the entire time here feeling like a prisoner and a lab rat, a curiosity, something to experiment on, not someone to have compassion for.<br><br> <span class = "eva">"But the Institute will know what to do, right?"</span> $eva.name protests, <span class = "eva">"they don't have to take him, they can just help us, right?"</span><br><br> $kaja.name's gaze falls on the younger woman, her eyes sad. Her look says it all: $eva.name is too naive, <span class = "kaja">"That would not be a possibility,"</span><br><br> <span class = "tara">"We could always use an extra sword,"</span> she says, as if it's decided already that you'd, what, work for them? Fight for them? That's just insane, you're a uni student, you have lectures and coursework to do, you can't just leave it all to go fight aliens or whatever.<br><br> $kaja.name looks over the red-haired girl, a gentle smile on her face, <span class = "kaja">"That brings me to my next point,"</span> she says, her face settling into a much more serious expression, flicking her eyes to $beth.nick for a moment, <span class = "kaja">"the Institute has reported that multiple rifts opened across the globe today, they believe rift activity is on the increase,"</span> sh casts her eyes around the room, looking at the shocked faces, <span class = "kaja">"so yes, we will need all the swords we can get,"</span><br><br> $niks.name, who has been quietly contemplating what everyone else has been saying, speaks up again, <span class = "niks">"I agree, we can't tell the Institute,"</span><br><br> $eva.name's eyes shoot over to her, full of betrayal, <span class = "eva">"$niks.name..."</span> she says dejectedly, <span class = "eva">"I thought you had my back,"</span><br><br> <span class = "niks">"I'm just looking at the bigger picture,"</span> $niks.name replies, <span class = "niks">"if rift activity is increasing, we can't lose a channeller to the Institute, we need him here,"</span><br><br> $eva.name just looks down at the ground between her feet, all of the excited energy banished, replaced with an air of dispondent hurt.<br><br> <span class = "kaja">"$beth.name, you have been rather quiet,"</span> $kaja.name says, inviting the muscular woman to share her thoughts.<br><br> $beth.nick simply shrugs and says, <span class = "beth">"As long as he's not a liability,"</span><br><br> <span class = "kaja">"Okay, it is decided then, we will keep this information from the Institute, that means nothing in reports and no idle chatter around your instructors, okay?"</span> the girls all murmur their consent with a handful of nods. $eva.name continues staring at the ground and gives an almost imperceptable nod, <span class = "kaja">"We will need begin training him on our own, and then, when he is ready, he can help us dealing with rifts,"</span><br><br> And there it is, a decision about your future, your entire life, made without your input. It's like they don't even care what you think, like it's a forgone conclusion, like your opinion doesn't matter.<br><br> <<button [[Speak up|0-1-afternoon-deciding-speak]]>><</button>><br><br> <<button [[Stay quiet|0-1-afternoon-deciding-no]]>><</button>> </p> <</nobr>><<nobr>> <div class = "achievementCont"> <<if ndef $busbra || if $busbra == false>> <div class = "achievement"> <div class = "achievementWrapper"> <div class = "achievementNumber"> <b>1</b> </div> <div class = "achievementTitle"> WANDERING EYES </div> <div class = "achievementText"> <<linkreplace "HINT">> Look at $sarah.name's chest while she stretches <</linkreplace>> </div> </div> </div> <<elseif $busbra == true>> <div class = "achievement"> <div class = "achievementWrapper"> <div class = "achievementNumber"> <b>1</b> </div> <div class = "achievementTitle"> WANDERING EYES </div> <div class = "achievementText"> You looked at $sarah.name's bra on the bus to town </div> </div> </div> <</if>> <div class = "achievement"> <<if ndef $busbra || if $busbra == true>> <div class = "achievement"> <div class = "achievementWrapper"> <div class = "achievementNumber"> <b>2</b> </div> <div class = "achievementTitle"> RESPECTFUL FRIEND </div> <div class = "achievementText"> <<linkreplace "HINT">> Keep your eyes to yourself on the bus <</linkreplace>> </div> </div> </div> <<elseif $busbra == false>> <div class = "achievement"> <div class = "achievementWrapper"> <div class = "achievementNumber"> <b>1</b> </div> <div class = "achievementTitle"> RESPECTFUL FRIEND </div> <div class = "achievementText"> You resisted the temptation to look at $sarah.name's bra </div> </div> </div> <</if>> </div> <div class = "achievement"> Test achievement 3 </div> <div class = "achievement"> Test achievement 4 </div> <div class = "achievement"> Test achievement 5 </div> </div> <</nobr>><<button "roll 1">> <<roll1 $player.fem>> <<goto [[Roll Test Result]]>> <</button>> <<button "roll 2">> <<roll2 $player.fem>> <<goto [[Roll Test Result]]>> <</button>> <<button "roll 3">> <<set $roll to undefined>> <<roll3 $player.fem>> <<if $roll3 >= 7>> <<goto [[roll success]]>> <<else>> <<goto [[roll
