$player.passage to passage()>> <<set $time.dayName to "???">> <<set $time.periodName to "">> <p> You clear your throat, <span class = "player">"Don't I get a say in this?"</span> it comes out angrier than you had planned, but then again, you are angry, <span class = "player">"none of you have asked me what I want to do,"</span><br><br> Every single eye in the room turns to you, looks of confusion playing across their faces. You sink back into your chair, wilting under their gaze. Fuck, maybe you should've just kept your mouth shut.<br><br> <span class = "tara">"You are a channeller, channellers are weapons against the riftspawn,"</span> $tara.name says, as if it were obvious, <span class = "tara">"we protect humanity, and now you're one of us, so you protect humanity too,"</span><br><br> You open your mouth to protest again, but $kaja.name walks over to where you're sitting, her face gentle, <span class = "kaja">"$tara.name is right, we are weapons, raised to fight and kill riftspawn, you have this power now, so you have a responsibility to use it for good,"</span><br><br> You scoff and roll your eyes, <span class = "player">"You're really giving me the 'with great power comes great responsibility' speech?"</span> $kaja.name gives you a questioning look, <span class = "player">"Look, I'm not a superhero okay? I'm just an ordinary student trying to get a degree,"</span><br><br> <span class = "kaja">"$player.name, you are not ordinary any more,"</span> she sighs, <span class = "kaja">"you have the ability to protect those you love, is it not irresponsible not to use it?"</span><br><br> Your mind is immediately bombarded with memories of your parents, your older sister, your new friends. Fuck. You hate to admit it but she might have a point.<br><br> <span class = "kaja">"We will train you to be powerful, and my girls will have your back, you will be a team,"</span><br><br> <span class = "player">"Fine,"</span> you sigh, there's no way you can change her mind. And honestly, there might be something to that old superhero speech. Damn it.<br><br> <span class = "kaja">"I think it is time we returned our belongings,"</span> $kaja.name looks back over her shoulder, <span class = "kaja">"$beth.name, could you please retrieve $player.name's bag?"</span><br><br> $beth.nick gives a slight nod and heads out of the room. Behind $kaja.name, $niks.name has gone back to her game and $tara.name has picked up a book, reclining with both her legs over the armchair's arm now. $eva.name still looks dejected and is picking at the hem of her top<<if hasVisited("0-1-afternoon-test-1-no")>> again<</if>>.<br><br> $kaja.name turns her attention back to you, <span class = "kaja">"Now, $player.name, you must keep everything related to being a channeller secret,</span> the way she looks at you impresses the importance of what she's saying, <span class = "kaja">"that means your powers, us, the rifts, the riftspawn, and the Institute,"</span><br><br> You nod, although you barely know anything about any of this, other than the fact that these girls, and you, can summon weapons out of thin air. You're pretty sure telling anyone about this stuff would be a good way to get sectioned.<br><br> <span class = "niks">"Why not just use oath magic?"</span> $niks.name says, her focus still glued to the game.<br><br> <span class = "kaja">"Oath magic doesn't work on channellers $niks.name,"</span><br><br> <span class = "niks">"Okay, but an hour ago he was an impossibility, and anyway, $eva.name's sleep magic worked on him,"</span> $niks.name shrugs, sounding entirely uninterested in the outcome of the discussion.<br><br> <span class = "kaja">"Sleep magic is far less complex, you should know this,"</span> $niks.name simply shrugs again, not pushing it any further as she blasts away on the screen. $kaja.name turns back to you, <span class = "kaja">"you agree to keeping this secret?"</span><br><br> <span class = "player">"Yeah,"</span> you nod again, <span class = "player">"anyway, if I did tell someone they'd just think I'm crazy,"</span><br><br> <span class = "kaja">"Good, we will return you to your city,"</span> well that confirms it, you definitely aren't in Loxham any more, <span class = "kaja">"I will send one of my girls to get you when it is time for training,"</span><br><br> <span class = "player">"Wait, you've barely explained any of this to me, like what rifts are and these riftspawn, or what the Institute is,"</span> you protest, still feeling out of your depth.<br><br> <span class = "kaja">"All in due time, $player.name,"</span> $kaja.name says, waving her hand dismissively, but your face makes it clear that won't do as an explanation, <span class = "kaja">"Some of your first lessons will be on the riftspawn, you must know your enemy to defeat them. As for the Institute, that will become clear in time,"</span><br><br> You sigh, you're clearly not gonna get any more out of her right now. At that moment, $beth.nick returns with your backpack, dumping it unceremoniously at your feet before dropping down on the sofa next to $niks.name. You immediately unzip it and begin rummaging through, making sure everything is still there. You breathe a sigh of relief. Nothing's missing. Although it's clear they've looked through your belongings as everything has been shoved back into the main compartment, not in their usual places.<br><br> <span id = "phone"> <<button "Check your phone">> <<set $time.dayName to "Tuesday">> <<set $time.periodName to "Afternoon">> <<script>>UI.update()<</script>> <<replace "#phone">> You grab your phone out and check for any messages, your sure someone is going to be worrying where you are.<br><br> <span class = "kaja">"The Sanctuary has a built in Faraday cage, you will not get any signal in here,"</span> $kaja.name explains, clearly having noticed you looking staring at your lack of messages or missed calls.<br><br> Great, so not only have you not been able to check your messages, if anyone had tried to call you in the time you've been gone they wouldn't have been able to get through even if you did have your phone on you. Well at least you're able to check the time. It's only been a few hours. That's some relief. Not much, but some.<br><br> <span class = "kaja">"Follow me,"</span> $kaja.name turns around and starts off toward the door, clearly expecting you to do as she says. It's not like you have a choice, she's the only way you'll be able to get back home, so you get back to your feet and sling your rucksack over one shoulder. $kaja.name walks around the sofa, making sure not to block the TV that $niks.name is so engrossed in, and $beth.nick watches with a detached sort of interest.<br><br> <<button [[Head home|0-1-afternoon-safehouse-leave]]>><</button>> <</replace>> <</button>> </span> </p> <</nobr>><<nobr>> <<set $player.passage to passage()>> <<set $time.dayName to "???">> <<set $time.periodName to "">> <p> There's no point in speaking up. What are you going to say? How are you gonna convince them not to make you fight? It just feels so pointless. Guess you should just resign yourself to this fate.<br><br> <span class = "kaja">"We will train you to be powerful, and my girls will have your back, you will be a team,"</span> $kaja.name says, her tone reassuring.<br><br> <span class = "player">"Okay,"</span> you sigh. That's some comfort at least. You won't be alone.<br><br> <span class = "kaja">"I think it is time we returned our belongings,"</span> $kaja.name looks back over her shoulder, <span class = "kaja">"$beth.name, could you please retrieve $player.name's bag?"</span><br><br> $beth.nick gives a slight nod and heads out of the room. Behind $kaja.name, $niks.name has gone back to her game and $tara.name has picked up a book, reclining with both her legs over the armchair's arm now. $eva.name still looks dejected and is picking at the hem of her top<<if hasVisited("0-1-afternoon-test-1-no")>> again<</if>>.<br><br> $kaja.name turns her attention back to you, <span class = "kaja">"Now, $player.name, you must keep everything related to being a channeller secret,</span> the way she looks at you impresses the importance of what she's saying, <span class = "kaja">"that means your powers, us, the rifts, the riftspawn, and the Institute,"</span><br><br> You nod, although you barely know anything about any of this, other than the fact that these girls, and you, can summon weapons out of thin air. You're pretty sure telling anyone about this stuff would be a good way to get sectioned.<br><br> <span class = "niks">"Why not just use oath magic?"</span> $niks.name says, her focus still glued to the game.<br><br> <span class = "kaja">"Oath magic doesn't work on channellers $niks.name,"</span><br><br> <span class = "niks">"Okay, but an hour ago he was an impossibility, and anyway, $eva.name's sleep magic worked on him,"</span> $niks.name shrugs, sounding entirely uninterested in the outcome of the discussion.<br><br> <span class = "kaja">"Sleep magic is far less complex, you should know this,"</span> $niks.name simply shrugs again, not pushing it any further as she blasts away on the screen. $kaja.name turns back to you, <span class = "kaja">"you agree to keeping this secret?"</span><br><br> <span class = "player">"Yeah,"</span> you nod again, <span class = "player">"anyway, if I did tell someone they'd just think I'm crazy,"</span><br><br> <span class = "kaja">"Good, we will return you to your city,"</span> well that confirms it, you definitely aren't in Loxham any more, <span class = "kaja">"I will send one of my girls to get you when it is time for training,"</span><br><br> <span class = "player">"Wait, you've barely explained any of this to me, like what rifts are and these riftspawn, or what the Institute is,"</span> you protest, still feeling out of your depth.<br><br> <span class = "kaja">"All in due time, $player.name,"</span> $kaja.name says, waving her hand dismissively, but your face makes it clear that won't do as an explanation, <span class = "kaja">"Some of your first lessons will be on the riftspawn, you must know your enemy to defeat them. As for the Institute, that will become clear in time,"</span><br><br> You sigh, you're clearly not gonna get any more out of her right now. At that moment, $beth.nick returns with your backpack, dumping it unceremoniously at your feet before dropping down on the sofa next to $niks.name. You immediately unzip it and begin rummaging through, making sure everything is still there. You breathe a sigh of relief. Nothing's missing. Although it's clear they've looked through your belongings as everything has been shoved back into the main compartment, not in their usual places.<br><br> <span id = "phone"> <<button "Check your phone">> <<set $time.dayName to "Tuesday">> <<set $time.periodName to "Afternoon">> <<script>>UI.update()<</script>> <<replace "#phone">> You grab your phone out and check for any messages, your sure someone is going to be worrying where you are.<br><br> <span class = "kaja">"The Sanctuary has a built in Faraday cage, you will not get any signal in here,"</span> $kaja.name explains, clearly having noticed you looking staring at your lack of messages or missed calls.<br><br> Great, so not only have you not been able to check your messages, if anyone had tried to call you in the time you've been gone they wouldn't have been able to get through even if you did have your phone on you. Well at least you're able to check the time. It's only been a few hours. That's some relief. Not much, but some.<br><br> <span class = "kaja">"Follow me,"</span> $kaja.name turns around and starts off toward the door, clearly expecting you to do as she says. It's not like you have a choice, she's the only way you'll be able to get back home, so you get back to your feet and sling your rucksack over one shoulder. $kaja.name walks around the sofa, making sure not to block the TV that $niks.name is so engrossed in, and $beth.nick watches with a detached sort of interest.<br><br> <<button [[Head home|0-1-afternoon-safehouse-leave]]>><</button>> <</replace>> <</button>> </span> </p> <</nobr>><<nobr>> <<set $player.passage to passage()>> <p> You follow $kaja.name out of the communal living space and into the corridor once again. She leads you back to the door that you remember leads down into the basement, pausing for a brief moment to make sure you are indeed following, and then slips inside.<br><br> Once again you take the steps with caution so as not to trip and break something. $kaja.name waits for you at the bottom, holding the door to the octagonal room you first found yourself in open. Now, being less confused and terrified, you manage to notice that there appear to be a few other rooms in the cellar, each with an identical nondescript door.<br><br> You enter the room with a slight bit of trepidation, your heartrate rising as your brain recalls everything that happened in here not that long ago. $kaja.name follows you in and quickly strides past you, heading directly for a wall with the freshest painted on glyphs.<br><br> <span class = "kaja">"Portal magic takes a while to get used to, you may feel nauseous upon passing through,"</span> she explains, <span class = "kaja">"Don't worry, you'll soon get used to it,"</span><br><br> $kaja.name waves her hand slowly over the sigils, muttering something under her breath. As she passes her hand over each one, it begins to glow a pale blue which spreads downwards through the glyphs until the entire archway is lit up.<br><br> Given she said portal magic, you expected the glowing, what you didn't expect is that the centre remains a solid concrete wall. No glowing portal or shimmering liquid like on fantasy and sci-fi shows. Nothing. Just bare concrete.<br><br> <span class = "kaja">"Do not worry, the portal is open,"</span> evidently she read the unvoiced question on your face, thrusting her arm at the wall. Sure enough, her arm passes straight through, the concrete seeming to ripple slightly, <span class = "kaja">"perhaps it is best if you close your eyes for the first time,"</span><br><br> You take a deep breath, steeling yourself to walk directly at a solid wall, and hopefully through it.<br><br> <span class = "kaja">"I am going to cast a glamour magic on us,"</span> $kaja.name beckons you over. Your steps are a little timid and unsure as you move to join her in front of the softly glowing archway, <span class = "kaja">"It is a simple magic that will make people ignore our presence for a short time. Now, give me your hands,"</span> you oblige, holding them up for her. She clasps your hands in hers and begins whispering, <span class = "kaja">"I am the shield that guards the world, I am the sword that pierces the rift, I call upon the power to shield us from view,"</span><br><br> You feel it. You actually feel it, like a gentle warmth washing over you. Apparently that's what magic feels like. Or at least this magic.<br><br> $kaja.name lets go of one of your hands and turns towards the portal, marching confidently forward. You let out a shaky breath, close your eyes, and allow yourself to be lead through.<br><br> <<button [[Enter the portal|0-1-evening-loxham-return]]>><<set $time.period += 1>><</button>> </p> <</nobr>><<nobr>> <<set $player.passage to passage()>> <p> The world lurches as you step into the portal, you feel it tugging at you clothes, your body. It feels like the ground has dropped out from underneath you, the horrible sensation of falling making your stomach drop.<br><br> And then it's over. You feel the cool air on your skin and hear the sounds of the city. You open your eyes, relishing the familiar sounds of life, enjoying the fresh air.<br><br> And then you double over. Nausea hitting you like a hammer. You turn and place your hand on the wall as you bend forward. But the wall isn't there. You watch in horror as your hand passes through the bricks like they were water, sucked back into the portal. You feel a hand on your shoulder, gripping your t-shirt as $kaja.name pulls you back, saving you from falling back through.<br><br> You vomit. You can't help yourself, the combination of the sensation of passing through the portal with the sight of watching your arm disappear through a solid wall forces you to retch. $kaja.name rubs your back, attempting to comfort you as you lose your breakfast and half a pint of $player.drink to the floor.<br><br> You heave a few more times, but thankfully nothing more comes out. You rinse your mouth outh with a swig of water from the bottle you thankfully shoved into your bag this morning, spitting it onto the ground. You're definitely going to have to brush your teeth when you get back home. Feeling at least a little more human, you take stock of where you are. The two of you are stood in a narrow alley flanked by the brick walls of buildings. You don't recognise it, but then again, it's not like you even know every alley of your home town, so that's not exactly surprising. Thankfully though, no one else is around, so you don't have to test the efficacy of the glamour magic, or whatever $kaja.name called it.<br><br> <span class = "kaja">"The Institute has informed the local authoritied that there was a chemical leak,"</span> $kaja.name says, ignoring the fact that you just threw up in front of you, <span class = "kaja">"they have decontaminated those we secured. I suggest you think of what you will tell your friends,"</span><br><br> <span class = "player">"Wait, but won't they remember that creature, the riftspawn?"</span> surely that would put a massive hole in the whole "chemical leak" story.<br><br> <span class = "kaja">"Do not worry, they have had their memories altered,"</span> $kaja.name says as if that's an entirely normal thing, <span class = "kaja">"they will simply remember a large bang and being told to stay inside,"</span><br><br> You open your mouth to respond about how insane that is, the fact the the Institute, whatever it is, can apparently wipe people's minds, but $kaja.name cuts you off, <span class = "kaja">"The glamour magic will wear off in a few minutes. In a few days, one of my girls will collect you for training,"</span> she says, walking back towards the portal. You have no idea how she knows where it is, the wall looks like a normal brick wall, nothing strange about it. But $kaja.name clearly knows what she's doing, <span class = "kaja">"get some rest,"</span> she spares you one final glance before walking through the wall accompanied by a slight ripple.<br><br> And then she's gone. And you are alone.<br><br> You breathe a sigh of relief. You're back. Back in Loxham. You only moved here a few days ago, but it's already begun to feel more and more like home. The relief you feel at being back here is palpable.<br><br> <<button [[Time to head back to campus|0-1-evening-campus-return]]>><</button>> </p> <</nobr>><<nobr>> <<set $player.passage to passage()>> <<set $time.period = 4>> <<print tags()>> <p> You walk through the city to a bus stop, marvelling at how quiet it is given it's a Tuesday evening. Blue flashing lights spill out down the streets, apparently from the cordon around where everything happened earlier. You glance back down one of the larger roads to see a few ambulances parked up with police cars blocking the road. Behind them is a large tent, and you can make out paramedics in protective equipment rubbing each other down with blue roll.<br><br> A thought pops into your head: you have service now. You pull out your phone and find no less than fifty messages waiting for you. Most are direct from $sarah.name, each one more worried than the last. $louis.name's messages follow are similar pattern. And then there's the group chat. You quickly scroll through a long conversation between your two friends, scanning each message. It starts with $louis.name asking the two of you if you were okay, and then $sarah.name moaning about how long she was kept there for, but it quickly turns into concern for you. Evidently both had tried to call you but were unable to get through. There's talk of reporting you as missing and telling your parents, but to your relief they decided to wait a bit longer.<br><br> Shit. They must have been worried sick. You quickly type out a message to the group chat.<br><br> <div class = "textReplyCont"> <div class = "textReplyFirst"> Hey guys, sorry, my phone died but I'm okay, I'll be back soon, just walking to the bus stop </div> </div> <br> The replies come in almost immediately.<br><br> <div class = "textCont"> <div style = "line-height: 60%;">$louis.name</div> <div class = "textFirst"> glad you're okay man 👍 </div> </div> <div class = "textCont"> <div style = "line-height: 60%;">$sarah.name</div> <div class = "textFirst"> good, let us know when you're on the bus, make sure you get home safe, okay? </div> <div class = "text"> I'll stilll be up when you get back, so don't worry about telling me you're home </div> </div> <br> You smile to yourself and slip your phone back in your pocket. You're glad to have made such good friends so early.<br><br> As you arrive at the bus stop there's a notice scrolling along the display: all services experiencing delays due to incident in city centre.<br><br> Great. Just what you need. After the day you've had, you want nothing more than to collapse in your bed spend a few hours pretending none of this ever happened. But that will have to wait apparently. Well he did have a while to catch his breath as the two of you caught up.<br><br> <span class = "louis">"Took your time, slowpokes!"</span> he laughs while you and $sarah.name come to a halt.<br><br> <span class = "sarah">"Well some of us don't feel the need to show off,"</span> she flashes him a cheeky grin, <span class = "come on, let's head up, I have a date with my mattress,"</span> $sarah.name taps her ID to the sensor, unlocking the door.<br><br> <</if>> <<if ndef _choice1>> <<button "Sprint to catch up">> <<set $louis.rel += 1>> <<notify 5s>>$louis.name Relationship Up<</notify>> <<set _choice1 = 1>> <<redo "choice1">> <</button>><br><br> <<button "Follow at a slower pace">> <<set _choice1 = 2>> <<redo "choice">> <</button>> <<else>> <<button [[Up the stairs to bed|0-2-night-ech-bed]]>><</button>> <</if>> <</do>> </p> <</nobr>><<nobr>> <<set $player.passage to passage()>> <p> It's slightly quieter over here, not by much, but enough that you don't have to strain your voice quite as much to be heard. You're pretty sure your throat is gonna be raw tomorrow.<br><br> You flop down onto the cushioned bench, not realising just how tired your legs are until the moment your butt hit the vinyl. Tucking your water under the bench to keep it safe from being knocked over by anyone walking by, you let out a long sigh.<br><br> <span class = "player">"Oh I needed this,"</span> you laugh.<br><br> <span class = "louis">"Tell me about it!"</span> $louis.name says as he drops down next to you, <<if $player.drink = "jaegerbomb">> <span class = "louis">"you know you have to down that, right?"</span><br><br> You roll your eyes at him, smiling, <span class = "player">"Well I didn't get it for the taste, so duhh,"</span><br><br> You bring the plastic rim to your lips and tip your head back, gulping it down as fast as you can, the alcohol burning slightly as the energy drink coats your mouth in sugary sweetness. You finish it quickly, not record time by any means, but fast enough, crushing the cup as you let out an exhale.<br><br> <<else>> <span class = "louis">"cheers,"</span> he raises his cup up.<br><br> You oblige, tapping the plastic rim of your cup against his with a grin, <span class = "player">"Cheers,"</span> you both take a swig of your drinks. The sweetness of the cider and the blackcurrant makes it <i>way</i> too easy to drink like juice.<br><br> <</if>> <span class = "louis">"Friday's gonna be so fucking sick!"</span> $louis.name exclaims, miming slashing the air with a sword.<br><br> For a moment your brain flashes back to yesterday, the feeling of the sword in your hand, the way it sat in your hand, it jarring your hand harmlessly bouncing of the creature's carapace. The fear. You shake your head, trying to banish the memories. You're a normal student having a normal night out with your normal friends. Nothing more.<br><br> <<if $player.hemaTaste == true>> You force a smile as the thoughts fade, <span class = "player">"Yeah, it's gonna be fun,"</span> you manage, somewhat halfheartedly. Thankfully it seems $louis.name doesn't notice.<br><br> <span class = "louis">"We're gonna hit eachother with swords!"</span><br><br> You can't help but laugh a little, he's so excited about it, and it definitely helps you feel more normal, <span class = "player">"You seem excited enough for both of us,"</span><br><br> <span class = "louis">"Are you not excited?"</span><br><br> <span class = "player">"I am, just not as much as you,"</span> you laugh.<br><br> And you are excited for it, maybe it'll be good to have something much more low stakes involving swords, not having to worry about being torn to pieces by alien creatures. <<if $sarah.know == true>> Plus $sarah.name was probably right, it'll be helpful to get more training.<br><br> <<else>> Plus the extra training might help keep you alive.<br><br> <</if>> <<else>> You force a smile as the thoughts fade, <span class = "player">"The hema thing?"</span> you manage, somewhat halfheartedly. Thankfully it seems $louis.name doesn't notice.<br><br> <span class = "louis">"Yeah! Gonna hit people with swords!"</span> $louis.name exclaims.<br><br> You can't help but laugh a little, he's so excited about it, and it definitely helps you feel more normal, <span class = "player">"Sounds like you're gonna love it,"</span><br><br> <span class = "louis">"Hell yeah!"</span> he grins, <span class = "louis">"You know, you could still come along,"</span><br><br> You're really not sure that's the best of ideas, <span class = "player">"Maybe, I dunno, not sure it's my thing,"</span> not sure I need more swordplay in my future.<br><br> <</if>> <span class = "louis">"Come on, let's go dance more!"</span> he says, draining the last of his snakebite.<br><br> <span class = "player">"Water first,"</span> you remind him <<if $player.drink == "snakebite">> , finishing your own snakebite.<br><br> <<else>> , sipping on your own water.<br><br> <</if>> <span class = "louis">"Fiiiiiiiine,"</span> $louis.name moans, picking up his water from the floor and gulping it down as fast as he can.<br><br> You roll your eyes and follow suit, making sure you can actually finish yours before he drags you back to the dance floor.<br><br> <<button [[Break time's over|0-2-night-ech-dance-3]]>><</button>> </p> <</nobr>><<nobr>> <<set $player.passage to passage()>> <p> You feel the music pulling you onwards as $louis.name leads you back to the dancefloor, making a beeline to the area close to the speakers. There are fewer people there, probably because not everyone likes the sensation of bass rattling your bones and sound assaulting your eardrums. Either $louis.name doesn't care or he likes the feeling, whichever you are powerless to resist, following him as he marches forward.<br><br> You pick up where you left off, quickly getting back into the rhythm, your body moving of its own accord, fuelled by alcohol and driven by the pounding bass. $louis.name immediately starts bouncing along to the beat, the extra space allowing him to really let loose as he jumps from side to side, throwing in a spin here and there, his arms alternating between punching the air and swinging by his sides. You can't help but grin, this boy has so much energy. It's infectious.<br><br> All of a sudden, you feel a hand on your lower back. Normally something like that would make you jump, but you're too drunk to care right now, you just slowly turn your head to see who it is.<br><br> You're met with $sarah.name's smiling face, <span class = "sarah">"Found you two!"</span> she says as the music takes hold of her as well, making her hips sway as she joins you.<br><br> The three of you dance together, enjoying each other's company, and the music, and the alcohol. There is nothing else but this moment, the whole world just melts away, leaving nothing but the three of you, dancing together, smiling at one another.<br><br> The time slips by in a haze of dancing and alcohol and music, until you hear the openning lines of Mr Brightside coming over the speakers. A loud cheer rips through the club as the entire room begins to drunkenly sing along. $sarah.name puts an arm around your shoulders, pulling you in against her side. $louis.name does the same from your right, so the three of you are stood in a line with arms on each other's shoulders as you sing along raucously.<br><br> The feeling of your friends by your side, and the whole of the ECH singing together, fills you with joy and you can't help but grin loudly as you belt the words at the top of your lungs. This is what it means to be a normal student. Drunkenly singing with entire club full of people, good friends by your side, ignoring everything outside these four walls. You feel like you could take on the world.<br><br> The song comes to an end and so does the night, the lights slowly coming up as people around you start to slowly file out. The three of you join the flow of people heading for the doors, letting yourselves be swept along, arms still around each other's shoulders.<br><br> You reach the doors and for some reason wordlessly decide to try get through them sideways, still connected in your little line. You all burst out laughing as you edge out sideways, bumping against one another as your feet threaten to get tangled up. But at last you manage it, spilling out into the cool night air and splitting apart in fits of giggles.<br><br> <<button [[Homeward bound|0-2-night-ech-flat]]>><</button>> </p> <</nobr>><<nobr>> <<set $player.passage to passage()>> <p> The three of you make the climb up to your flat in comfortable silence, all looking forward to crawling into bed.<br><br> <span class = "sarah">"Goodnight you two,"</span> $sarah.name says as you pile into the hallway and stagger to your rooms.<br><br> <span class = "player">"Night,"</span> you reply as you unlock your bedroom door, <span class = "player">"sleep well,"</span><br><br> <span class = "louis">"You too,"</span> $louis.name yawns, finally showing any sign of being tired.<br><br> Stumbling into your room, you kick off your shoes and start to strip down, not even bothering to turn on the light. You throw your teeshirt onto the floor as you collapse down onto your mattress, dragging your legs out of your jeans.<br><br> <<button [[To sleep perchance to dream|0-3-early-room-hangover]]>><<set $time.period += 1>><</button>> </p> <</nobr>>
